items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Well I don't know, Dick. A long time I see something like when he playing the thrills like that, you know. ... I know he used to play a trap, he used to play drums right now, trap drums, you know. I know he did. But I don't know if he continued.

ctx.x: Did son work in his band, my son, a few hours?

Well I don't know, Dick. A long time I see something like when he playing the thrills like that, you know. Yeah. But if he working in other kind of, work with Dixie Land band, I don't know, you know. But I know he used to play a trap, he used to play drums right now, trap drums, you know. I know he did. But I don't know if he continued. I don't know. Probably he could be doing playing with the band, you know. You ever hear Howard play the drums much? Oh yeah, Howard. That's Howard for example, played drums.
Did you ever hear Howard play the drums much?
